descriptions.zh: 我们已经找到了一个损毁的巨型结构残骸。该构造显然亟需修复，同时我们也在其数据库中发现了饱含着有关异星生物的见解的宝贵财富。尽管我们还在决定是否要重建这一远古科技的造物，我们的考古学家有机会去发掘并取回这宇宙设备起源的线索。它的其中一个发明者，“量子建筑师”相关的日志似乎格外有价值。恢复这些文件对我们解密遗留给我们科技的远古种族的文化和历史必然有着莫大的帮助。
descriptions.en: We have found the wreckage of a ruined megastructure. The construct is obviously in desperate need of repairs, and we've found a wealth of xenological insights in its databanks. While we're deciding whether to rebuild this ancient technology, our archaeologists have an opportunity to extract and recover clues to the origin of this cosmic device. A series of logs from one of the inventors, the 'Quantum Architect,' seems especially promising. Recovering files should help us decipher the culture and history of the ancient race that left us this tech.

descriptions.zh: 我们自[From.Planet.GetName]的偏远山谷捕捉到了一束独特的信号。由于信号源离这颗星球上的任何已存在文明都十分遥远，追踪这束信号、搞清楚它的来源，或许会有特殊意义。
descriptions.en: We have picked up a unique signal from a remote valley on [From.Planet.GetName]. As the signal's source is far away from any civilization that has existed on the planet, it might be of interest to track it down and figure out where it is coming from.

descriptions.zh:
一艘我们的飞船在探索[Root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的时候偶然在位于[Root.Planet.GetName][Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName]的卫星上发现了一艘坠毁的小型飞船。

这艘飞船上的标志与符号我们从未见过。些许样本已经被提取并用于进一步研究，但飞船本身过大且不够牢固，无法移动，我们只能就地进行分析研究了。
descriptions.en:
One of our ships analyzing the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system has come across a small crashed ship on the moon of [Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName], [Root.Planet.GetName].

It bears no emblems or sigils we have seen before, and some samples have been brought back to be tested further, but the vessel itself is much too large and unstable to be moved. Additional analysis and testing will have to be done on-site.
